description: 🏰 The Maze Game offers straightforward maze navigation challenges, built with Prim's & DFS Algorithms. Featuring responsive design for easy play on any device, including mobile, with intuitive on-screen controls for movement, it's ideal for quick gaming sessions, providing both casual and challenging experiences!
readme:
# 🎮 The Maze Game - Full-Stack JavaScript Game with Express API and MongoDB

<div align="center">

**A fully-featured maze game: procedural mazes, difficulty levels, A\* hints, accounts, per-user stats & progress, achievements, global leaderboards, and multiplayer — with a MongoDB-backed, Vercel-deployable API documented in Swagger.**
